title: A-3A Gunnery Scope Presentation, B-52 aircraft no. 394, unidentified blip
description: Hand-annotated radar scope chart on an Air Intelligence Information Report (AF Form 112, Part II) from the 22d Bombardment Wing (M), page 2 of 2, titled "A-3A GUNNERY SCOPE PRESENTATION, B-52 ACFT. NUMBER 394." A grid with range marks from 1,000 to 8,000 shows a "Blip of unidentified aircraft" near 6,000 noted as a "Smaller return than that produced by B-52," a "Blip produced by second B-52 in cell" near 3,000, and a dashed arrow with the note "Disappeared off scope in direction of Baghdad Flight Identification Region." A footer note gives the B-52's contact parameters as altitude 39,000 feet and speed 462 knots true air speed; the form is stamped SECRET (struck through).
